newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Pryca to pay dividend, issue premium.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Pryca to pay dividend, issue premium.

text.p: Spain's hypermarket chain Pryca said on Thursday it would propose paying a gross 65 pesetas per share dividend versus 1996's results.
The 1996 total dividend will be 12.03 billion pesetas, a 51.4 percent higher than 1995's.
Pryca will also pay an additional 133 pesetas per share as issue premium for its 1992 capital increase. The total per share payment will add to 198 pesetas.
The Pryca group had a turnover of 594.52 billion pesetas in 1996, and a net profit of 23.95 billion pesetas, 10.2 percent higher than previous year.
